sections.body:
The Corner Table began as a small kitchen with a big table. Today it is a neighbourhood restaurant and bar where regulars and first-timers share wood-fired pizza, handmade pasta, grills, curries and a long list of drinks.

We cook from scratch, buy from nearby suppliers when we can, and keep the music live on weekends. There is a private dining room for groups, parking, and step-free access throughout.
